claims.claim: At Meta Connect 2026, Meta showcased its personal AI agent, Muse, expanding hands-free assistant capabilities across smart wearables.
claims.notes: Verified primary announcement from Meta Connect 2026.

claims.claim: Muse Spark 1.3 is Meta's flagship frontier reasoning model featuring a 1-million token context window and a multi-agent Contemplating architecture.
claims.notes: Orchestrates parallel reasoning agents to tackle complex long-horizon workflows without spiking latency.

claims.claim: Muse is built for agentic execution—autonomously booking travel, managing calendars, and handling real-time voice translation across 14+ languages.
claims.notes: Direct shift from conversational Q&A to autonomous tool and task execution.

claims.claim: Meta expanded its AI glasses ecosystem with over 100 style variants planned by late 2026, introducing camera-free Ray-Ban Meta Audio and previewing 100g VR glasses.
claims.notes: Includes Ray-Ban Meta Audio dedicated to voice-first AI interaction and Project Phoenix VR glasses.

claims.claim: Muse is an ambient AI assistant on wearables and software; Meta has not released full humanoid robotics or commercial brain-computer hardware.
claims.notes: CRITICAL BOUNDARY: Clarify this is wearable smart glasses audio/vision AI, not invasive hardware or physical robotics.

editorial_cautions: Distinguish between camera-equipped Ray-Ban Meta glasses and newly introduced camera-free Ray-Ban Meta Audio.
Do not confuse Project Phoenix (Spring 2027 VR glasses) with currently shipping AI smart glasses.
